description: TeX64 turns course material into Japanese lecture notes, exam summaries, exercise sheets, and simple academic reports. Users describe the result in ordinary language; TeX64 handles typography and production details on its own server and returns a finished PDF with page previews. Compilation runs in a throwaway sandbox with no network access. PDF links are temporary and expire within the hour; TeX64 keeps no accounts or document history.
